SO I TRIED TO STRIP AWAY THE GOVERNMENT'S LANGUAGE, THE LANGUAGE THAT WAS DELIBERATELY DESIGNED TO SOFTEN THE REALITY OF WHAT WAS HAPPENING. MARCIA 	MARCIA FRANKLIN, HOST: COMING UP, I TALK WITH BEST-SELLING AUTHOR DANIEL JAMES BROWN ABOUT HIS NEWEST BOOK, “FACING THE MOUNTAIN.” BOOK COVER – FACING THE MOUNTAIN IT PAYS HOMAGE TO THE BRAVERY OF THE 442ND, AN ALL JAPANESE-AMERICAN REGIMENTAL COMBAT TEAM THAT FOUGHT IN WORLD WAR II. LOGO THAT’S “CONVERSATIONS FROM THE SUN VALLEY WRITERS’ CONFERENCE,” NEXT. STAY TUNED. (OPEN) INTRODUCTION (1:30) MARCIA HELLO AND WELCOME TO DIALOGUE. I’M MARCIA FRANKLIN. WHEN AUTHOR DANIEL JAMES BROWN WAS GROWING UP, HE WOULD WATCH HIS USUALLY SOFT-SPOKEN FATHER BECOME ANGRY AS HE TOLD HIS SON ABOUT WHAT HAD HAPPENED TO MANY OF HIS JAPANESE-AMERICAN FRIENDS DURING WORLD WAR II. PHOTO AFTER PEARL HARBOR, THEY HAD BEEN ROUNDED UP FROM THE WEST COAST AND SENT TO CAMPS FURTHER INLAND THAT WERE SURROUNDED BY BARBED WIRE AND GUARD TOWERS, INCLUDING ONE IN MINIDOKA, IDAHO. COVER -- BOYS IN THE BOAT . BUT BROWN, WHO WOULD GO ON TO WRITE THE BESTSELLING BOOK, “THE BOYS IN THE BOAT,” WOULDN’T LEARN MUCH MORE ABOUT THAT PERIOD OF HISTORY FOR MANY YEARS. IKEDA? THEN, WHEN HE WAS CASTING ABOUT FOR HIS NEXT BOOK TOPIC, HE MET TOM IKEDA, THE DIRECTOR OF DENSHO. DENSHO WEBSITE THAT’S A NONPROFIT DEDICATED TO PRESERVING THE STORIES OF JAPANESE-AMERICANS DURING WORLD WAR II. BROWN BECAME FASCINATED WITH THE TOPIC, AND DECIDED TO MAKE IT THE SUBJECT OF HIS NEXT BOOK. BOOK COVER: FACING THE MOUNTAIN “FACING THE MOUNTAIN: A TRUE STORY OF JAPANESE AMERICAN HEROES IN WORLD WAR II,” DELVES DEEPLY INTO THE LIVES OF SEVERAL OF THE MEN WHO FOUGHT IN THE 442ND REGIMENTAL COMBAT TEAM. PHOTO SOME EVEN DID SO WHILE THEIR OWN FAMILIES WERE INCARCERATED IN THE UNITED STATES MERELY FOR BEING OF JAPANESE DESCENT. THE BOOK, WHICH TOOK BROWN MORE THAN FIVE YEARS TO WRITE, HAS BECOME A BESTSELLER. I HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO TALK WITH HIM AT THE 2021 SUN VALLEY WRITERS’ CONFERENCE. TWO SHOT	WE SPOKE ABOUT HOW HE CHOSE THE STORIES IN THE BOOK, AND HOW THE LANGUAGE WE USE TO TALK ABOUT THAT ERA HAS CHANGED DRAMATICALLY.
